# Triono Hidayat

> Senior Full-Stack Solutions Developer & IT Systems Officer. Specializing in high-performance Next.js web applications, native Android solutions, RFID/WMS logistics, and n8n workflow automations.

## Overview
Triono Hidayat is an Indonesian software engineer, IT Systems Officer, and solutions consultant with 8+ years of cross-industry experience. He bridges public-sector GovTech standards (Ministry of Manpower / Kemnaker RI), RFID/WMS logistics engineering, and modern full-stack web and mobile engineering for international clients.

- Enterprise Systems & Leadership: IT Project Management (Agile, Jira), GovTech Information Systems, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Technical Documentation & SOPs.
